summary: Removed Personnel In-Charge column that displayed which personnel was assigned to each vehicle
failure_scenario: User views fleet overview and cannot see which personnel is responsible for each vehicle, leading to unclear accountability and inability to quickly identify vehicle-personnel assignments

summary: Removed Status column that displayed vehicle operational status information
failure_scenario: User cannot see vehicle status (e.g., maintenance, expired, normal) when reviewing fleet, potentially leading to deployment of unsuitable vehicles or missed maintenance alerts

summary: Removed Last Update column that showed when vehicle data was last refreshed
failure_scenario: User cannot determine how current the vehicle information is, risking decisions based on stale data without knowing the last update time

summary: Removed personnel_id field from add vehicle form, preventing assignment of personnel to vehicles
failure_scenario: When adding new vehicles to the fleet, users cannot assign personnel to those vehicles, breaking the vehicle-personnel linkage functionality

summary: Removed personnel_id field from edit vehicle form, preventing modification of personnel assignments
failure_scenario: When editing existing vehicles, users cannot change or update which personnel is assigned to the vehicle, preventing correction of incorrect assignments
